name: Liquid Smear
description: Pigment drag along the pointer's real travel direction, taken from a spring-damped cursor and its velocity in extraBuffer[133..136] — the previous version always pulled toward the cursor centre, which reads as a sink rather than a brush. A five-tap kernel bleeds pigment along the stroke normal with a width set by the local FFT bin. History is fetched with exact textureLoad, bilinear by hand.

updatedParams.name: Smear Strength
updatedParams.description: Drag length along the pointer stroke.

updatedParams.name: Brush Size
updatedParams.description: Radius of the drag falloff around the cursor.

updatedParams.name: Persistence
updatedParams.description: How much of the smeared field survives each frame.

updatedParams.name: Mix Strength
updatedParams.description: Blend of the smeared field over the live plate.
